add_mesh_object — DRIVE terrain op

• Data kinds: table × table → scalar

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.add_mesh_object(world: 'dict', mesh: 'dict', x: 'float', y: 'float', yaw: 'float', *, name: 'str' = '', z: 'float' = 0.0) -> 'int' (to call the implementation directly, import driveterrain; driveterrain.add_mesh_object(world: 'dict', mesh: 'dict', x: 'float', y: 'float', yaw: 'float', *, name: 'str' = '', z: 'float' = 0.0) -> 'int'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("add_mesh_object"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

手続き的なメッシュ(tree_mesh / pedestrian_mesh …、原点 = 底面中心)を姿勢に置いて世界に足す。

資産と同じ `pose/dims を持たせるので :func:driveworld.world_move` で動かせる。
